title: Generation of Engineered Human Myocardium in a Multi-well Format
author: Tiburcy, Meyer, et al.

steps.title: Prepare Matrigel aliquots
steps.instruction: Thaw Matrigel (7–10 mg/mL) on ice for 16–24 h at 4 °C, mix gently by slow inversions, dispense 250 µL into 50 mL centrifuge tubes on ice using ice‑cold tips, freeze aliquots at –20 °C and store up to 12 months.

steps.title: Coat T75 flask with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Resuspend a frozen Matrigel aliquot in 29.75 mL ice‑cold PBS (1:120 dilution), add 6 mL to a T75 flask, ensure uniform coverage, incubate ≥60 min at 20–25 °C or store coated flask at 4 °C for up to 14 days (prevent drying).

steps.title: Seed cardiomyocytes (post‑dispersion)
steps.instruction: Warm Matrigel‑coated flask to 20–25 °C and Cardio Culture Medium (CCM) to 37 °C, centrifuge cardiomyocytes in Cardio Recovery Medium (CRM) at 200 × g for 7 min at 4 °C, aspirate Matrigel, add 5 mL CCM, discard supernatant, resuspend cells in 10 mL CCM, seed at 0.1–0.2 × 10⁶ cells/cm², replace 15 mL CCM every other day.

steps.title: Thaw cryo‑preserved cardiomyocytes (alternative)
steps.instruction: Warm CRM and a Matrigel‑coated flask to 20–25 °C, warm CCM to 37 °C, thaw cardiomyocyte vials at 37 °C for 3 min, disinfect with 70 % EtOH, transfer suspension with a 2 mL serological pipette to a tube, wash vial with 1 mL CRM and add dropwise, add another 8 mL CRM, centrifuge at 200 × g for 7 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 mL CCM, strain through 70 µm mesh, count cells, aspirate Matrigel from flask, add 5 mL CCM, seed at 0.1–0.2 × 10⁶ cells/cm², replace 15 mL CCM every other day.

steps.title: Prepare RPMI 10× stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 104 mg/mL RPMI powder in ddH₂O while rotating at 37 °C for 1 h, filter‑sterilize, aliquot and store at –20 °C for up to 12 months.

steps.title: Prepare 2× RPMI working solution
steps.instruction: Mix RPMI 10× (volume as needed) with B‑27 supplement minus insulin (0.8 × volume) and ddH₂O (7.2 × volume) to obtain a 2× solution; optionally add 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 µg/mL streptomycin, store at 4 °C for up to 14 days.

steps.title: Prepare recombinant protein stocks
steps.instruction: Dissolve IGF‑1 to 100 µg/mL, VEGF165 to 5 µg/mL, FGF‑2 to 10 µg/mL, and TGF‑β1 to 5 µg/mL in PBS containing 0.1 % recombinant albumin; aliquot and store at –20 °C for up to 12 months (thawed stocks kept at 4 °C ≤1 week).

steps.title: Prepare L‑ascorbic acid 2‑phosphate stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 4.3 g L‑ascorbic acid 2‑phosphate in 50 mL ddH₂O to make a 300 mM stock, mix until dissolved, filter‑sterilize, aliquot and store at –20 °C for up to 12 months.

steps.title: Prepare 0.1 N NaOH
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 N NaOH 1:9 with ddH₂O, filter‑sterilize, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Formulate EHM medium (EHMM)
steps.instruction: For each mL of EHMM combine: Iscove’s with Glutamax (500 µL), MEM non‑essential amino acids (5 µL), B‑27 supplement minus insulin (20 µL), L‑ascorbic acid 2‑phosphate (300 µM, 0.52 µL), IGF‑1 (100 ng/mL, 0.52 µL), VEGF165 (5 ng/mL, 0.52 µL), FGF‑2 (10 ng/mL, 0.52 µL); total volume 527.8 µL per mL. Optionally add 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 µg/mL streptomycin; store at 4 °C ≤14 days.

steps.title: Add TGF‑β1 to EHMM (EHMM+T)
steps.instruction: To 49.95 mL EHMM add 0.05 mL TGF‑β1 (5 µg/mL) to obtain 5 ng/mL final; total 50 mL. Store at 4 °C ≤14 days.

steps.title: Formulate Cardio Culture Medium (CCM)
steps.instruction: Combine RPMI 1640 with Glutamax (500 µL), sodium pyruvate (1 mM, 5 µL), B‑27 supplement (10 µL), L‑ascorbic acid 2‑phosphate (200 µM, 0.35 µL); total 515.45 µL per mL. Optionally add antibiotics as above; store at 4 °C ≤14 days.

steps.title: Formulate Cardio Recovery Medium (CRM)
steps.instruction: Mix Cardio medium (49.95 µL) with Y27632 (10 mM stock) to a final 10 µM (0.05 µL); total 50 µL. Add antibiotics optionally; store at 4 °C ≤14 days.

steps.title: Enzymatic dispersion of cardiomyocytes
steps.instruction: Warm CRM, PBS, and Accutase to 20–25 °C; warm Versene to 37 °C. Aspirate medium from cardiomyocyte‑seeded flask, add 6 mL Accutase, incubate 15–45 min at 20–25 °C until cells detach (add 6 mL Versene when larger aggregates lift, incubate additional 5 min). Stop digestion with 12 mL CRM, gently pipette, transfer to tube. Wash flask with 6 mL CRM, add to tube, centrifuge 200 × g 7 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 mL CRM, strain through 70 µm mesh, count cells, keep on ice.

steps.title: Enzymatic dispersion of fibroblasts
steps.instruction: Warm CCM and TrypLE Express to 37 °C. Wash fibroblasts with 6 mL TrypLE, aspirate, add another 6 mL TrypLE, incubate 5–10 min at 37 °C. Stop with 12 mL CCM, pipette, pass through 70 µm mesh into a 50 mL tube, count cells, keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare cryo‑preserved fibroblasts (alternative)
steps.instruction: Warm CCM to 15–25 °C, thaw fibroblast vials at 37 °C for 3 min, disinfect with 70 % EtOH, transfer suspension with 2 mL serological pipette to tube, wash vial with 1 mL CCM and add dropwise, add another 8 mL CCM, centrifuge 300 × g 5 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 mL CCM, strain through 70 µm mesh, count cells, keep on ice.

steps.title: Determine EHM numbers and prepare cell mix
steps.instruction: Based on live cell counts on ice, calculate required cardiomyocytes and fibroblasts for each EHM (e.g., 0.385 M cardiomyocytes + 0.165 M fibroblasts for 1 EHM; include 10 % surplus). Transfer appropriate cell numbers to a tube, centrifuge 200 × g 7 min at 4 °C, aspirate supernatant, resuspend pellet in cold EHMM (volume per Table 2). Keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare EHM hydrogel on ice
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL tube on ice add in order: acid‑soluble collagen (volume per Table 2), 2× RPMI (volume per Table 2), 0.1 N NaOH (volume per Table 2), then the cold cell mix. Mix each addition by gentle swirling.

substeps.instruction: For 1 EHM: 44 µL collagen (6.84 mg/mL), 44 µL 2× RPMI, 6 µL 0.1 N NaOH, 104 µL cell mix.
For 4 EHM: 264 µL collagen, 264 µL 2× RPMI, 63 µL NaOH, 624 µL cell mix.
For 8 EHM: 422 µL collagen, 422 µL 2× RPMI, 288 µL NaOH, 992 µL cell mix.

steps.title: Neutralize and homogenize hydrogel
steps.instruction: Triturate the entire suspension >10 times with a serological pipette; verify pH neutralization by phenol‑red turning from yellow to pink. Work quickly to avoid premature collagen solidification; pipette slowly to prevent air bubbles.

steps.title: Cast hydrogel into 48‑well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 180 µL of the hydrogel into each well of a 48‑well EHM plate using a 1 mL pipette tip, tap plate gently to spread evenly, avoid bubbles and breaks in the gel.

steps.title: Incubate for collagen condensation
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator; let the hydrogel settle for 1 h until it appears opaque.

steps.title: Add EHMM+T medium
steps.instruction: Carefully add 600 µL of pre‑warmed (37 °C) EHMM+T to each well without disturbing the gel; incubate 24 h.

steps.title: Medium exchange during early culture
steps.instruction: For the first three days, replace 500 µL of EHMM+T per well daily; thereafter continue feeding with EHMM (no TGF‑β1) daily (or every other day as desired).

steps.title: Long‑term feeding and monitoring
steps.instruction: Exchange 500 µL of EHMM per well daily (or every other day) for the remainder of the culture (up to 28 days or longer). Monitor contractile activity by video‑optic analysis; spontaneous contractions typically appear after ~3 days and increase over the first 2 weeks.
